title: MC: Refreshed
description: Vanilla+ expansion! Graphical and World Generation Improvements.
body:
![MC: Refreshed Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/040f2860fad085b82dfcb7f18a7070110a4c3d84.png)



# Info
A Vanilla+ Modpack, heavily expanding upon graphics and world generation.  
Expanding Minecrafts Progression and Content, without doing too much.  
Improving the ambiance and immersion of Minecraft.

# Features
- Voice Chat
  - Microphones and Speakers
  - Groups
  - Voice Chat Messages
- World Generation
  - More Structures
  - Bigger Biomes
  - Custom Biomes
  - Better Underground
  - More Blocks
- Waystones Quick Travel
- Seasons
- Mob Vote loosers re-added
- Better animations
  - 3D First person items
  - Animated Player & Mobs
- Performance-friendly pre-configured Shaders


<details>
<summary>Multiplayer</summary>

There is currently no simple server pack or friend joining. You are able to make a server by just copying the mods and configs.
e4mc and Essential work with the pack, but aren't icluded.
A dedicated server pack is planned.

</details>



# Performance
A performance-friendly Shader is enabled by default, but can be disabled in Settings.

<details>
<summary>How to change/disable Shader</summary>

1. "Options" (Levers icon on title screen)
2. "Video Settings"
3. "Shader Packs" (On the left side in the "Iris" Section)
4. Click on "Shaders: Enabled" and "Done" to disable, or change it to another one in the list and configure it using "Shader Pack Settings..."

</details>



<details>
<summary>Disabling Resource Packs</summary>

If you don't like the default resource packs, or if they are causing problems with yours, you can disable them by **pressing F12 in the resource packs screen**

</details>



# Finding Bugs
You can report bugs on [Github](https://github.com/fex2000/minecraft-refreshed-1.21.11/issues).
